topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: The words I poured into the spaces, the thoughts that took flight from the quiet of my mind, now echo beyond the walls of my solitude. They sit there, on the page, open to eyes not my own. Each sentence, a creature of my making, now roams freely in the world. They speak of me, yet speak to all, weaving the tapestry of my ambitions and dreams. This canvas, once blank, now carries my hues and shadows, shared and seen, a testament to the silent labor of my thoughts.
